inspection_summary: Full 680-line inspection found a transform-based RH equivalence: totient-weighted discrete measures converge vaguely to a continuous measure; their Mellin transform is a test-function factor times a ratio of shifted zeta functions; contour location and convergence rate therefore encode zero-free half-planes, with RH giving the critical rate. Smoothness supplies Paley-Wiener decay needed for contour shifts, while characteristic functions have a separate sharp discrepancy barrier. The scan text has serious formula loss, so accepted mathematics is limited to mechanisms recoverable from prose and all exact identities need original-page verification.
